agent.title: Choose an agent
agent.description: Nexus uses an agent to run strategies. Select a discovered agent to continue.

workspace.title: Name your Profile
workspace.description: Nexus creates your first Profile. Choose a display name and a workspace folder for your creative projects. We will create the folder if it does not exist.

done.title: You're ready 🎉
done.description: Open Nexus to start writing. You can change settings anytime.

error.title: Could not scan for agents

empty.description: Install an agent, or continue with a custom launch command.

workspace.label: Workspace folder
workspace.browserOnly: Workspace path changes are available on the desktop app only.

starting.description: This takes a few seconds on first launch.
